  * `migrations/0000_wooden_the_hood.sql` — first real migration (auth tables). **Applied.** `user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`, `__drizzle_migrations` all exist in `public`.
  * `load-env.ts` — custom `.env` loader that preserves URL-encoded passwords in `DATABASE_URL` (required when passwords contain `+`, `/`, etc.).
  * `drizzle.config.ts` sets `migrations.schema: "public"` so Drizzle's migration-tracking table lives in `public` instead of creating a separate `drizzle` schema (least-privilege: one schema, one grant).

* `apps/api` — Fastify backend with **Better Auth authentication foundation** (this milestone):
  * Extended config: `DATABASE_URL`, `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, `BETTER_AUTH_URL`, `WEB_ORIGIN` (all zod-validated).
  * `src/auth/index.ts` — `createAuth(config, db)` using Better Auth Drizzle adapter (`better-auth/adapters/drizzle`) with the shared `@opensuite/db` Drizzle client — no second PostgreSQL pool.
  * `src/routes/auth.ts` — mounts Better Auth handler at `GET|POST /api/auth/*` (official Fastify integration pattern).
  * `src/app.ts` — registers `@fastify/cors` (origin = `WEB_ORIGIN`, credentials enabled) + auth routes. `buildApp` is now async.
  * `src/server.ts` — creates one `@opensuite/db` client, passes `db` into `createAuth`, closes pool on shutdown.
  * Email/password + sessions enabled. No OAuth, workspaces, or product routes.
  * `src/auth/session.ts` — `getRequestUser(auth, request)`: the single place protected routes resolve the current user via `auth.api.getSession`. Returns only `{ id, name, email }` (`AuthenticatedUser`), never the full Better Auth session/account object.
  * `src/routes/me.ts` — first OpenSuite-owned protected route, `GET /api/me`: `401 { error: { code: "UNAUTHENTICATED" } }` with no session, `200 { user: { id, name, email } }` with one.
  * Tests: 13 unit/integration tests pass, including the live DB-backed sign-up → session → `/api/me` flow (opt-in via `RUN_DB_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true`).
* `.env` at repo root points `DATABASE_URL` at the dedicated `opensuite` database (not `khaata` — that was a stale/incorrect value from an earlier session, now corrected). `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, `BETTER_AUTH_URL`, `WEB_ORIGIN` also set (gitignored).
* Docs: `docs/architecture.md` updated with auth + Better Auth decisions.
* Root `package.json` has convenience scripts (`dev:api`, `db:generate`, `db:migrate`, `db:check`) so all common commands run from the monorepo root — no need to `cd` into individual packages.

## Just Completed

Added the first OpenSuite-owned protected route, `GET /api/me`, proving Better Auth sessions work end-to-end through Fastify: unauthenticated requests get `401`, authenticated requests get a minimal `{ id, name, email }` user object (never the full session/account). Verified against the `opensuite` database (previous session used the wrong `khaata` database by mistake — `.env` now correctly points at `opensuite`). Did not implement frontend, workspaces, OAuth, storage, agent-core, or engine work.

## Root Cause of the Migration Failure (resolved)

The `opensuite_app` PostgreSQL role had neither `CREATE` on the `khaata` database nor `CREATE` on the `public` schema. Drizzle's Postgres migrator (`drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator`) unconditionally runs `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS <schema>` before creating its `__drizzle_migrations` tracking table — in Postgres this statement requires database-level `CREATE` privilege even when the schema already exists (the privilege check happens before the existence check). `drizzle-kit migrate` swallows the underlying `pg` error and only prints "Exit status 1", which is why the real cause (`permission denied for database khaata`, then `permission denied for schema public`) was hidden. Running the migrator directly via a small script surfaced the actual `pg` error.

Two changes were made:
1. `packages/db/drizzle.config.ts` now sets `migrations: { schema: "public" }` so Drizzle's tracking table lives in `public` rather than provisioning a separate `drizzle` schema — one schema, one grant, less privilege surface.
2. The `opensuite_app` role was granted `CREATE` on the `khaata` database and on the `public` schema (done externally by the user as a DB admin — not performed by the agent). With both grants in place, `pnpm --filter @opensuite/db db:migrate` now succeeds.

## Current Decisions

* **Auth:** Better Auth owns the auth schema — generated via `auth@latest generate`, stored in `packages/db/src/schema/auth.ts`, migrated via Drizzle Kit. No custom user/session tables.
* **DB client reuse:** `apps/api` creates one `createDbClient()` pool and passes `db` to both Better Auth (Drizzle adapter) and future product code. Single lifecycle, closed on shutdown.
* **Fastify integration:** Official pattern — convert Fastify request → Fetch `Request` → `auth.handler()` → forward response. Route: `/api/auth/*`.
* **CORS:** `@fastify/cors` with `origin: WEB_ORIGIN`, `credentials: true`. Better Auth `trustedOrigins: [WEB_ORIGIN]`.
* **Env loading:** Custom `load-env.ts` in `apps/api` and `packages/db` reads repo-root `.env` without URL-decoding values. Passwords with special characters must be URL-encoded in `DATABASE_URL`.
* **Integration tests:** Auth DB integration test requires `RUN_DB_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true` (opt-in, after migration applied).
* **Protected routes:** all protected routes should resolve the current user via `getRequestUser(auth, request)` in `src/auth/session.ts` (wraps `auth.api.getSession`), not by calling Better Auth directly. This keeps "authenticated user" a single, deliberately small shape (`id`, `name`, `email`) instead of each route deciding what to expose from the full session/account/user record.

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| `pnpm db:check` | **Pass** — PostgreSQL reachable (`opensuite` database) |
| `pnpm db:migrate` | **Pass** — auth migration applied |
| Auth tables exist (`user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`, `__drizzle_migrations`) | **Pass** — confirmed in `public` schema of `opensuite` |
| `pnpm build` / `pnpm typecheck` | **Pass** — all packages |
| `pnpm test` (workspace, DB-independent) | **Pass** — 12/13 (DB integration test skipped by default) |
| `RUN_DB_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true pnpm --filter @opensuite/api test` | **Pass** — 13/13, including sign-up → session → `/api/me` |
| Live smoke test: sign-up, then `GET /api/me` with/without session cookie against running `apps/api` | **Pass** — `200 { user: { id, name, email } }` authenticated, `401` unauthenticated |

No known blockers remain for the authentication foundation. If your PostgreSQL password contains `+`, `/`, or other URL-special characters, keep them URL-encoded in `DATABASE_URL` (e.g. `+` → `%2B`, `/` → `%2F`) — the custom `load-env.ts` loader does not decode them.

## Developer Command Guide

Run all commands from the monorepo root: `/Users/iamshiva/Documents/startups/opensuite-project/opensuite`

```bash
# Install
pnpm install

# Run API only (watch mode)
pnpm dev:api

# Run whole dev workspace (all apps/packages in watch mode)
pnpm dev

# Generate a new Drizzle migration (after schema changes)
pnpm db:generate

# Apply pending Drizzle migrations
pnpm db:migrate

# Check DB connectivity
pnpm db:check

# Run all tests (DB-independent by default)
pnpm test

# Run tests including the live DB auth integration test
RUN_DB_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true pnpm --filter @opensuite/api test

# Typecheck / build everything
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
```
